title: Classical and Quantum Information Theory
description: Classical and quantum information measures. Source coding theorem. Capacity of discrete memoryless channels and the noisy channel coding theorem. The rate-distortion theory. Gaussian channel capacity. Quantum source coding. Quantum channel capacity.
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: ( IEOR E3658 ) or or a course in stochastic processes.
